title: Apply for a Letter of Accreditation (registered surveyor)
summary: Land or mining surveyors registered in NSW can apply to the Board of Surveying and Spatial Information (BOSSI) for a letter of accreditation to practice in another jurisdiction.
intro:
Land or mining surveyors registered in NSW can apply to practise in another jurisdiction by applying to the Board of Surveying and Spatial Information (BOSSI) for a letter of accreditation.

If approved, BOSSI will email a copy of the letter to the applicant who can then apply to their nominated surveying Board or equivalent surveying body.
who_can_apply: Holders of current surveyor registration with BOSSI.
what_you_need: Name of the jurisdiction you want to practice in
Credit or debit card to pay the application fee

how_to_steps.text: Select the 'Next' button on the application screen.
Log in, or create your MyServiceNSW Account, or log in using your OneGov credentials.
Follow the prompts to apply for a letter of accreditation.

external_links.text: Board of Surveying and Spatial Information (BOSSI)

internal_links.text: Update your registered surveyor contact details

faqs.q: What is a letter of accreditation?
faqs.a: If approved, BOSSI will email a copy of the letter to the applicant, who can then use it to apply to their nominated surveying Board or equivalent surveying body.

faqs.q: Who can apply for this letter of accreditation?
faqs.a: Holders of current surveyor registration with BOSSI.

faqs.q: What do I need to apply?
faqs.a: You need a MyServiceNSW Account or OneGov account, your surveyor licence or registration number, the name of the jurisdiction you want to practice in, and a credit or debit card to pay the application fee.
